faqs.a:
It shall be unlawful for any person to hold a special event or for a property owner
               to permit a special event to be held on his property without obtaining a permit therefor
               in compliance with the provisions of the Land Development Code. For the purposes of
               this section, special event shall be defined by the Land Development Code.
(Code 1981, § 21-32; Ord. No. 2532, § 1, 7-18-1988)
